$comment: Each option of the FetchArgs type of plugins/actions/fetch.ts of the Datastar 1.0.5 client whose type is a set of strings, read from its TypeScript: values are those strings, compared the strings the source compares the option with (=== or !==), and throws the errors it throws with the option in their detail. A value it compares with none of them takes the branch of a value it never compares with, or, when every value is compared, the else that throws.
